info.title: Local Planner API
info.description: Local-only planning API. Browser mutations require X-CSRF-Token matching the lp_csrf cookie. Versioned edits/deletes require If-Match. Multi-record commands carry expected versions in their JSON body. Errors use code/message/details/request_id.
